description: This file is a shell script used for testing documentation and help output consistency for Git commands, including verifying the presence, format, and coherence of command help messages and documentation files.

methods.name: help_to_synopsis
methods.description: Extracts the help synopsis of a specified built-in command by running it with -h and processing the output.

methods.name: builtin_to_adoc
methods.description: Returns the path to the .adoc documentation file for a given built-in command.

methods.name: adoc_to_synopsis
methods.description: Extracts the synopsis section from a given command's .adoc documentation file.

methods.name: check_dashed_labels
methods.description: Checks if the provided file contains dashed labels, ensuring no underscores or other characters.

methods.name: align_after_nl
methods.description: Adjusts text alignment after new lines to ensure consistent spacing.
